items.content_html: Stratum-HQ is a high-fidelity human dataset enrichment engine. It transforms raw images into dense, multi-layered training data by integrating T5-Large text embeddings, DINOv3 visual and spatial tokens, and 133-point DWPose keypoints. Optimized for Sapiens and consumer GPUs, it bridges the gap between pixels and anatomical structure.

items.content_html: Phyll AI is a fully offline crop diagnostic platform. It features a modular architecture where users download models specifically trained for their specific crops (e.g., Rice, Tomato). It allows swapping backbones like DINOv3 or MobileNet based on device hardware, providing high-precision, research-backed leaf analysis anywhere.
